name: St Vincent de Paul, Over Hulton

auditTrail.note: From the point on the Bolton - Salford District boundary, opposite Oxford Road and by a bee-line N including Rawsthorne Wood and Markland plantation and excluding Brancker Street, crossing Manchester Road (A6) and Punch Lane to M61 Motorway (excluding junction 5 slip roads).
